Agent Name: WebSurfer

Step Number: 10

Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer mistakenly identified "Icehouse: The Martian Chess Set" as being released in 1999, based on the visible excerpt from the BoardGameGeek page, without confirming the earliest edition year. The consistent information from previous steps indicated Icehouse pieces were released in 1989, which was the correct earliest release year for Icehouse. This mistake led to repeated incorrect confirmation of the release year throughout the conversation.
